title: The Slower Ball — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
You grip it differently
You release it the same way
Everything about the body says express
And then the ball arrives at a different speed to the one he expected

[Verse 2 — Español]
La bola más lenta es una conversación sobre el tiempo [The slower ball is a conversation about time]
Sobre qué tan rápido crees que eres [About how fast you think you are]
Y qué tan rápido eres en realidad [And how fast you actually are]
Esas son frecuentemente dos cosas diferentes [Those are frequently two different things]

[Chorus — English]
The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting
The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it
The slower ball says — you've made up your mind already
The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it

[Bridge — Français]
La balle plus lente dit — je sais ce que tu attends [The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting]
La balle plus lente dit — et je ne vais pas le faire [The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it]
La balle plus lente dit — tu as déjà décidé [The slower ball says — you've already decided]
La balle plus lente dit — c'est le problème, non? [The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Most batsmen know the slower ball is coming
That's not the point
The point is knowing it's coming and still not being ready

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The slower ball
La bola más lenta [The slower ball]
La balle plus lente [The slower ball]
That's my boy
